name: Sakura no Shippo ~Sakura Tale Fandisc~
original_name: さくらのしっぽ～さくらテイルファンディスク～
source:
This is the fandisk to Sakura Tale. It features after stories for each of the 6 heroines from the original game, as well a route for Natsumi. There’s also an extra story featuring a crossover with [url=/v1733]Asanagi no Aquanauts[/url], however characters from that game will not show up.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Sakura Tale》的Fan Disc，收录原作六名女主角各自的后日谈，以及夏美路线。另有一篇与[url=/v1733]《Asanagi no Aquanauts》[/url]联动的额外故事，不过该作角色并不会实际登场。

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
